'''Egg tong sui''' is a classic ''[[tong sui]]'' (sweet soup) within [[Cantonese cuisine]]. It is also known as ''daan tong sui'' or ''sweet egg soup''. It is essentially a sweet version of [[egg drop soup]] as it is considered a traditional Chinese dessert soup.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Anthony |first=Anita |date=2025-11-03 |title=Egg Tong Sui Recipe : A Silky, Sweet Chinese Dessert Soup That’s Comforting and Nourishing |url=https://www.eatshinebloom.com/2025/11/egg-tong-sui-recipe-a-silky-sweet-chinese-dessert-soup-thats-comforting-and-nourishing.html |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=Eat Shine and Bloom |language=en-US}}</ref>
